title: Remove command owner-page flat alias
summary: Removed the transitional flat window.commandHistoryOwnerPage export while preserving mediaPipelineCommandHistory.commandHistoryOwnerPage and routing touched WebView consumers/tests through the namespace.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in the command-history domain without changing backend-owned command behavior or media safety boundaries.
behavior_before: commandHistory.js exposed commandHistoryOwnerPage through both the mediaPipelineCommandHistory namespace and a direct window.commandHistoryOwnerPage flat alias; Completed evidence, Diagnostics, and browser smokes still read the flat alias.
behavior_after: commandHistoryOwnerPage remains available through window.mediaPipelineCommandHistory only; touched WebView consumers and browser smokes read that namespace. The active flat-export total drops from 630 to 629.
rollback_plan: Restore window.commandHistoryOwnerPage in commandHistory.js, switch the touched WebView consumers and browser smoke assertions back to the flat alias, regenerate the WebView public contract and summaries, restore the inventory/current-state flat-export counts, and rerun the same WebView static and browser smoke checks.
